name: Azure Container Apps
short_description: Azure Container Apps is a fully managed, serverless container platform built on Kubernetes, KEDA, Dapr and Envoy, where Microsoft runs the underlying cluster and apps can scale to zero.

evidence.quote: That's exactly the gap as your container apps fills.
Azure Container Apps is a fully managed, serverless container platform built on top of Azure Kubernetes service.
Azure Container Apps can host persistent MCP servers that need stateful session management.
